text: STM32G0B1: native UCPD/USB, TMC UART, SWD, classical CAN, temperature and control inputs.
C1/C2: VDD/VDDA; C3: VREF+; C4: VBAT; C5: NRST
C2 effective capacitance under 3.3 V bias requires qualification
Unused GPIO: firmware analog mode. HSI48/CRS for USB; no external crystal.
AS5600, 3.3 V, I2C address 0x36 - optional assembly population
PGO retains internal pull-up; OUT unused. Volatile settings only; OTP programming excluded.
DIR=GND: clockwise viewed per datasheet. Motor-side orientation must be calibrated.
14HM11-0404S has no rear shaft. Open-loop review default: U4/C6 unpopulated; no magnet or feedback qualified.
FDCAN2 in classical CAN mode, up to 1 Mbps; no CAN FD data phase
RS pulled high selects standby at reset; PB3 selects active high-speed mode. VREF unused.
R50 is DNP by default. Populate its zero-ohm link ONLY on CAN bus endpoints to enable R49 termination.
AP63203 fixed 3.3 V; input requires upstream inrush and reverse-current protection
C8/C9: 50 V; C10: 100 nF / 50 V bootstrap; C11/C12: 22 uF / 25 V nominal each
0.3 A logic budget proposed; effective capacitance, startup, ripple and thermal tests pending
Buck and motor bulk capacitors are behind the TPS26600 controlled-slew, reverse-blocking input.
VM from TPS26600; motor connector fitted. Regenerative energy qualification pending; ENN high during 5 V bootstrap.
1 ohm / 0.25 W precision sense pair: about 0.32 A peak at full scale; 10k/10k VREF avoids low-reference operation.
200 uF / 35 V bulk nominal; capacitor ripple, polarity, startup and thermal qualification pending
TCPP01 protects CC and drives Q_PD; TPS26600 limits inrush and supplies the buck and motor rail.
Initialize UCPD sink Rd BEFORE raising PB12/DB. PA9/PA10 grounded; motor ENN remains pulled high.
TCPP OVP: 22.51 V nominal. Downstream eFuse OVP: 22.02 V nominal; transient qualification remains pending.
D_VBUS is input surge protection, NOT a motor brake. USB data: direct FS PHY, 90-ohm routing pending.
USB-C supplies the target. Programmer signals must be 3.3 V; its VOUT is deliberately disconnected.
U8 gates all four channels until 3.0 V rail qualification plus 200 ms. TMUX powered-off signal limit is 3.6 V.
NRST has its own channel; programmer reset does not disable the other channels. Verify SWD timing on the prototype.
STEP/DIR/ENABLE: 3.3 V logic only. Limits: normally closed dry contacts to GND; open circuit is a fault.
TMP112 address 0x48; board temperature only. Firmware must enforce motor current and temperature limits.
J_MOTOR A1/A2 = one winding; B1/B2 = the other. Confirm cable colors against exact motor before use.
Autonomous USB bootstrap; GPIO high-current mode requires a validated >=1.5 A PD contract. Motor ENN stays high at 5 V.
2.2 uF dVdT to isolated RTN: nominal slew 0.0526 V/ms. 24k gives 0.50 A; parallel branch gives 1.00 A. Firmware must limit USB bootstrap draw.
MODE to RTN: current limit with automatic retry; SHDN internal pull-up enables startup. Hold ENN high on fault. RTN must remain separate from GND. Reverse blocking is not a brake.
